title: Canonical module base-change open comparison
statement: Choose the shared derived categories and additive tensor pullbacks [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $f:X\to S$, $g:S'\to S$, $g':X'\to X$ and $f':X'\to S'$ be scheme morphisms forming a cartesian square [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $G$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-module and $c:Lg'^*(G[0])\to(g'^*G)[0]$ satisfy IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison [def-pc-derived-module-base-change-map]. For arbitrary opens $V\subseteq S$, $W\subseteq S'$ with $W\subseteq g^{-1}V$, set $U=f^{-1}V$, $f_V=f|_V:U\to V$, $g_V=g|_W:W\to V$, $H=G|_U$, $P=U\times_V W$, $p:P\to U$, and $q:P\to W$. Let $R:D(S')\to D(W)$ be the exact derived restriction [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. There exist $c_V:Lp^*(H[0])\to(p^*H)[0]$ satisfying IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison, isomorphisms $a:R(Lg^*Rf_*(G[0]))\cong Lg_V^*Rf_{V,*}(H[0])$ and $b:R(Rf'_*(g'^*G)[0])\cong Rq_*((p^*H)[0])$, for which $R(\beta\mathbin{\gg}Rf'_*(c))\mathbin{\gg}b=a\mathbin{\gg}(\beta_V\mathbin{\gg}Rq_*(c_V))$, where $\beta$ and $\beta_V$ are the canonical derived mates of the original and chosen restricted pullback squares [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. No affineness, flatness or quasi-coherence is assumed.

proof.text: Put U = f inverse image of V and Z = f' inverse image of W. The restricted square with vertices Z,U,W,V is cartesian: a map to U and W agreeing over V composes to a cone for the original square, whose unique lift lands in Z. Identify Z with the chosen pullback of f restricted to V and g restricted from W to V. Both projections agree under this identification.

Apply the pullback restriction comparison to g and direct-image restriction to f. Exact restriction takes G[0] to H[0], yielding a. Apply direct-image restriction to f', and identify restriction of g'^*G with the ordinary pullback of H under the first projection, yielding b. These are isomorphisms.

3. Unpack hc as a left-derived counit epsilon. For a complex K on U, evaluate epsilon on its termwise extension by zero to X, restrict the result to Z, and use the projection comparisons to regard it as a counit for the first projection. Extension by zero is exact and preserves K-flatness: tensoring an extension by zero with a test complex is extension by zero of the tensor with its restriction, and both restriction and extension by zero preserve acyclicity. Thus the new counit is invertible on K-flat representatives and has the left-derived universal property. Naturality at the extension-by-zero counit j_!(M|U) -> M shows that its value on M|U agrees with epsilon on M restricted to Z. In particular this holds for M = G[0]. Compose the value on H[0] with the single-complex identification to obtain c0 and its comparison predicate. This transports the supplied epsilon, including any automorphism in its choice, rather than choosing an unrelated one.

Transpose the derived mate of Tag 08HY under the restricted adjunction. The open-square identity for underived mates commutes with restriction on complexes. Localizing and using the derived adjunction equations gives the same identity for the derived mate. Naturality of the direct-image restriction comparison then composes this identity with the transported epsilon, giving the displayed square. No invertibility of the base-change arrow is asserted. The argument is valid for empty opens and the zero module.

theorem exists_canonicalModuleBaseChange_open_comparison
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (a : Y ⟶ Z), (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback a).Additive]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (G : X.Modules)
    (c : (derivedPullback g').obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G) ⟶
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X'.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').obj G))
    (hc : IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison g' G c)
    (V : S.Opens) (W : S'.Opens) (hWV : W ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
    let U := f ⁻¹ᵁ V
    let fA := f ∣_ V
    let gA := g.resLE V W hWV
    let H := (schemeOpenRestriction X U).obj G
    let E := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G
    let E0 := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj H
    let R := (schemeOpenRestriction S' W).mapDerivedCategory
    ∃ c0 : (derivedPullback (pullback.fst fA gA)).obj E0 ⟶
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (pullback fA gA).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst fA gA)).obj H),
      IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison (pullback.fst fA gA) H c0 ∧
      ∃ a : R.obj ((derivedPullback g).obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E)) ≅
          (derivedPullback gA).obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage fA).obj E0),
      ∃ b : R.obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f').obj
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X'.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
                ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').obj G))) ≅
          (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd fA gA)).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (pullback fA gA).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
                ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst fA gA)).obj H)),
        R.map (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f f' g g' sq.w E ≫
            (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').map c) ≫ b.hom =
          a.hom ≫
            (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap fA (pullback.snd fA gA) gA (pullback.fst fA gA)
              pullback.condition E0 ≫ (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd fA gA)).map c0)
